name: message-queue-ordering-p2
prompt: how do I make sure events for the same account are processed in the order they happened when I have multiple queue workers

chunks.content: the admin queue viewer shows pending and in-flight job counts with a refresh every five seconds
partitioned the events table by month to keep indexes small
messages that fail five times are moved to a dead-letter queue for manual inspection
a pool of workers drains the email queue and sends through the transactional provider
deleted a long-since-launched feature flag and its dead branches
the image pipeline runs resize and watermark as two queued steps
while an account's message is in flight we hold a per-account lock so a second worker cannot start the next event for that account early
format totals in the buyer's currency at render time
alert when consumer lag on any partition exceeds 10k messages
decided to hash each message onto a partition by account id, so every event for one account always lands on the same partition and is consumed in arrival order
high-priority jobs jump ahead by living on a separate queue the workers poll first
failed jobs are retried with jittered backoff to avoid a thundering herd
stamp each event with a monotonic sequence number per account and drop any message that arrives out of order so we never apply an older state after a newer one
only one worker is allowed to consume a given partition at a time, which preserves per-account sequencing even though the overall pool is parallel
